description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Shiloh,” your sacred place in Seacrest West. Enjoy mornings by your private pool, afternoons exploring 30A beaches on 4 bikes, and evenings in a spacious fenced in yard by the fire pit under the stars. Just a 1-min walk from beach access with stunning Gulf views, “Shiloh” is more than a vacation home—it’s where memories are made, and stress melts away. Ready to escape? Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps from Seacrest West Beaches – Just a 1-minute walk to the pristine shoreline, where soft sand and turquoise waters await your perfect beach day.Private Pool with Fenced Yard & Cozy Fire Pit – Relax in your own pool, surrounded by a spacious fenced yard perfect for family fun, and unwind around the fire pit under the stars.4 Bikes for Adventure – Cruise along 30A’s scenic trails and charming neighborhoods, discovering the beauty and laid-back vibe of the area.Spacious Living with Gourmet Kitchen – An open-concept design invites laughter and connection, while the fully equipped kitchen sets the stage for memorable family meals.Comfortable Sleeping Arrangements – 3 luxurious suites and a cozy bunk nook accommodate up to 11 guests, perfect for family or group vacations.Partial Gulf Views from the 3rd Floor Balcony – Enjoy stunning glimpses of the Gulf while sipping your morning coffee or watching the sunset.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The pool area was a highlight for our family, and the short walk to the beach made our trip so convenient!" – Sean B.⭐ "Beautiful house, perfect location, and the included bikes made exploring so much fun!" – Kriston F.⭐ "A fantastic spot for our group of 10. Spacious, clean, and so close to everything we needed!" – Rhonda M.*** LIVING AREAS ***Enter a spacious, open-concept living area thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection. With plush seating, a flat-screen TV, and sophisticated coastal-inspired décor, it’s the ideal retreat to relax and recharge after a day by the sea.Experience cozy, stylish furniture thoughtfully designed to blend comfort and elegance, perfect for both relaxation and entertaining guests.Enjoy an open-concept living and dining area that creates a spacious feel, with seamless indoor-outdoor flow ideal for hosting or unwinding in a serene atmosphere.Enhance your leisure time with a smart TV offering a premium entertainment experience, perfect for movie nights or streaming your favorite shows.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***At the heart of “Shiloh” lies a contemporary kitchen designed for effortless home cooking. Featuring stainless steel appliances, generous countertop space, and a dining table that comfortably seats six, this kitchen makes preparing and enjoying meals both simple and enjoyable.Gourmet kitchen featuring premium stainless steel appliances, including a high-end refrigerator, oven, microwave, and dishwasher, perfect for preparing meals with ease and style.Spacious dining table comfortably seats 6, ideal for family meals or dinner parties, with additional counter seating for 4, great for casual breakfasts or quick snacks.Fully equipped with modern cookware, utensils, and essentials, ensuring you have everything you need to create delicious meals.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The expansive backyard is your personal haven, offering something for everyone to enjoy. It features a large private pool where you can cool off on hot summer days, a propane grill perfect for whipping up delicious outdoor meals, and a cozy fire pit ideal for gathering around in the evenings with friends and family.The spacious lawn by the wrap-around covered porch provides plenty of room for yard games like cornhole or frisbee, making it the perfect setting for fun-filled afternoons. Upstairs, a second-floor wrap-around balcony offers peek-a-boo Gulf views and a serene space to relax with a cup of coffee or unwind in the evening.Whether you're hosting a barbecue, relaxing by the fire, enjoying a friendly game, or soaking in the views from the balcony, this outdoor area is designed to create lasting memories.Enjoy a private pool complete with a spacious sundeck and comfortable loungersHost perfect poolside barbecues with a convenient propane grillUnwind by the fire pit, surrounded by cozy seating, and soak in starlit eveningsMake the most of the expansive fenced yard and grassy front area, ideal for games and outdoor activitiesRelax on the wrap-around covered front porch with plenty of outdoor seatingTake in the views from the second-floor wrap-around balcony, the perfect spot to relax and recharge*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed with sliding doors direct to the private pool, Smart TV, and access to the shared guest bathroom.Shared Guest Bathroom: Single vanity + tub/shower combo2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, Gulf-view balcony, en-suite with dual vanity + walk-in tiled showerQueen Guest Suite: 2 Queen beds (Sleeps 4), balcony access with Gulf views, shared bathroom with tub/shower combo3rd FloorBunk Nook: Twin-over-Full bunk bed (Sleeps 3), with playful décor and access to the 3rd-floor balcony with partial Gulf Views*** ADDITIONAL HOME PERKS ***Laundry Room: Equipped with a washer and dryer for guest convenienceIncluded Bikes: 4 bikes available to explore the local areaHigh-Speed Wi-Fi: Enjoy free, reliable internet throughout the homeAmple Parking: Plenty of parking space to accommodate multiple vehicles*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the prestigious Seacrest Beach West community, "Shiloh" offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Just a short walk from pristine beaches and the lively attractions of 30A, this retreat puts you at the heart of it all. Take a leisurely bike ride or stroll to the charming destinations of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, or enjoy family-friendly fun at The Big Chill.Beach access – Just a 3-minute walk, feel the sand between your toes and the ocean breeze on your face in moments.The Big Chill – Only a 3-minute drive away, enjoy live entertainment, delicious dining, and a laid-back, fun-filled energy.Alys Beach – A 5-minute ride to stunning architecture, whitewashed streets, and a luxurious, serene atmosphere.Rosemary Beach – A 5-minute ride to charming cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a lively yet elegant vibe.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Internal fireplace is NOT for guest use.Pool is heated between September 1st and April 30th.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 54592STRO #: STR-054592
